title: Exchanging Currency
context: Maya 准备去日本旅行，在兑换处把美元换成日元；店员 Jordan 说明当天汇率和手续费，核验护照并完成兑换。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Hi, I'd like to exchange some US dollars for Japanese yen, please.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想把一些美元换成日元。

dialogue.speaker: Jordan
dialogue.en: Of course. How much would you like to exchange today?
dialogue.zh: 当然可以。你今天想换多少？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Three hundred dollars. What's the rate today?
dialogue.zh: 三百美元。今天的汇率是多少？

dialogue.speaker: Jordan
dialogue.en: It's 148 yen to the dollar. There's also a small service fee.
dialogue.zh: 一美元兑 148 日元。另外还要收一笔小额手续费。

dialogue.speaker: Jordan
dialogue.en: Five dollars. We can take it from the dollars or out of the yen. Either way is fine.
dialogue.zh: 五美元。我们可以从美元里扣，也可以从日元里扣。两种都可以。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Please take it out of the yen. Do you need to see my ID?
dialogue.zh: 请从日元里扣吧。需要看我的证件吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jordan
dialogue.en: Yes, a passport or a driver's license is fine. I'll also need to count the cash.
dialogue.zh: 需要，护照或驾照都可以。我还需要清点一下现金。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Sure. Here's my passport and the three hundred dollars.
dialogue.zh: 好的。这是我的护照，还有这三百美元。

dialogue.speaker: Jordan
dialogue.en: Thanks. Everything looks good. Please sign the receipt here.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。都没问题。请在这张回单上签字。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Got it. Will I get a better rate if I come back later?
dialogue.zh: 好的。如果我晚一点再来，汇率会更好吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jordan
dialogue.en: It might change, but not by much today. Here's your yen and your copy of the receipt. Have a good trip!
dialogue.zh: 可能会变，但今天幅度不会太大。这是你的日元，还有回单副本。祝你旅途愉快！

expressions.en: I'd like to exchange some US dollars for Japanese yen
expressions.zh: 想把美元换成日元，在兑换处说明兑换方向时常用。
expressions.example: Hi, I'd like to exchange some US dollars for Japanese yen, please.

expressions.zh: 今天的汇率是多少？询问当天牌价的常用问法。
expressions.example: Three hundred dollars. What's the rate today?

expressions.zh: 手续费。兑换处常会另外收取一小笔费用。
expressions.example: There's also a small service fee.

expressions.en: take it out of the yen
expressions.zh: 从日元里扣除（手续费），用来选择扣费方式。
expressions.example: Please take it out of the yen.

expressions.zh: 祝你旅途愉快！在顾客办完兑换、准备出发时常用的道别。
expressions.example: Here's your yen and your copy of the receipt. Have a good trip!

pronunciation: exchange 读作 /ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ/，重音在第二音节；yen 读作 /jen/；receipt 的 p 不发音，读作 /rɪˈsiːt/；license 读作 /ˈlaɪsəns/；dollar 的重音在第一音节 /ˈdɑːlər/。

practice.title: Part 1 · Travel money
practice.prompt: Do you usually exchange money before you travel?
practice.answer: Yes, I do. I like to exchange a little cash before a trip, so I can pay for a taxi or a snack when I arrive. I usually keep the rest of my money on a card.

practice.title: Part 2 · Exchanging money
practice.prompt: Describe an imagined time you exchanged money for a trip. Say where you were, what currency you needed, and how you asked about the rate and the fee.
practice.answer: Imagine that I am at a currency exchange desk because I am going to Japan. I tell the clerk I would like to exchange three hundred US dollars for Japanese yen, and I ask about the rate today. The clerk explains the rate and a small service fee, and I ask them to take the fee out of the yen. I show my passport, sign the receipt, and take the cash for my trip. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Cash and cards
practice.prompt: Why do some travelers prefer to use cards instead of cash?
practice.answer: Cards can be safer to carry, and you do not have to exchange a large amount of cash in advance. They also make it easier to keep a record of spending. Still, a little cash is useful when a shop or a taxi does not take cards.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先听完整对话，再逐句跟读，再完成口头练习。
practice.answer: 用四到六句向兑换处说明你想把美元换成日元、询问当天汇率和手续费，并请对方从日元里扣除费用。
